steps.note: Read a field instead of validating it: `manni meta get type docs/guide.md`.
Validate stdin: `cat page.md | manni meta validate - --as markdown`.
Check only Markdown: `manni meta validate docs/ --ext md`.
Exclude drafts on the command line: `manni meta validate docs/ --exclude "**/drafts/**"`.
A bare `manni meta validate` reads the collections, so the collection's `exclude:` skips the drafts.

scaffolding: docs/guide.md (type concept) and docs/widget.mdx pass; docs/drafts/wip.md has no `type`, so a walk that includes the drafts fails. page.md is a passing document to pipe in on stdin. manni.config.yaml already declares the page's `pages` collection with `exclude: ["**/drafts/**"]`, so the bare run skips the drafts.
